page.layout: One page of running text, Latin with a few underlined passages. Running head and page number at the top. Small marginal marks in the right margin, beside the lines "Ita in hac secunda", "In tertia uero" and "Phocas". No notes under the text.

main_text.p: quum rursum mystice adumbrantur: cuius sessori datum est, pacem de terra sumere, & inuicem intersicere. Unde sicut in prima classe, Romani pontifices sub episcoporum nomine, per incorruptum uerbi ministerium & fidei constantiam, stellae in Christi dextera manentes fuerunt, Apoc.1. Ita in hac secunda, sub Archiepiscoporum & Patriarcharum appellatione- ., per eiusdem uerbi neglectionem ac terrenas affectiones, stellae cadentes ad terram ceciderant, Apoc.6. In tertia uero3., quae statim sequetur, sub Papatum & Antichristorum uocabulo, per plenam à Christo defectionem & apertas idololatrias, sidera in terram delapsa erunt, Apoc.9.
main_text.head: Tertia Classis.
main_text.p: Tertia & ultima Rom. episcoporum classis, à Bonifacio tertio ad Paulum quartum: in qua ipsissimos esse Antichristos, in carnis superbia gloriantes, atq; in tyrannide Satanam imitantes, aperte se ostendunt.
main_text.head: Abadon, uel Latinus Antichristus.
main_text.p: Anno ab incarnatione Domini 604. Phocasc tyrannus peremit suum Dominum, Caesarem Mauritium, una cum uxore, fratre, ac liberis, multisq; proceribus. Ad hunc annum, additis adhuc duobus annis, usq; ad Papatus initium per eundem Phocam, sunt 666. anni, à consulatu Marci Tul-

page.notes: Underlining under "Romani pontifices", "Ita in hac se", "In tertia uero, quae statim" and "Abadon, uel Latinus Antichristus." is set as printed by a rule or emphasis and is not transcribed as italic. The marginal marks ("ȷ" at the Romani line, "- ." and "3." on the right, "c c" beside Phocas) are small and doubtful; they are copied as best read. A stray mark in the left margin near "Bonifacio" is ignored as stain or show-through. The line "ipsissimos" is set as printed; the line break after "ip" is not clearly hyphenated. The signature "lij" is read as "iij" with a doubt. The "Papatum" and "ceciderant" readings are doubtful. "sidera" is read despite the long-s look.
